about: SCION 17 trace: what Biscuit did, per scene frame, measured from the render. x_screen/y_screen: centroid of the dog's painted silhouette (1x px). x_world_measured: that centroid back through the frame's camera (metres; the film cuts from WIDE to CLOSE at frame 606). x_anchor_measured: centre of the painted body piece, in metres. x_score: the score x the dog was staged at. facing: 1 = head toward the door (screen left), -1 = away, 0 = toward camera, from the painted nose relative to the painted skull; while look = in the back of the head is up (no nose painted) and facing is recorded as 1.
